title: Group logs with a Map
hints: Two type parameters: `T` for the items and `K` for whatever `getKey` returns. The return type is then `Map<K, T[]>`.
Loop over the items, compute `const key = getKey(item)`, then either push onto the existing group or create a new one.
const group = groups.get(key); if (group) group.push(item); else groups.set(key, [item]);
